title: Verificar José V11 en navegador representativo con red permitida
mission: Open the isolated public Jose V11 candidate in a representative JavaScript browser whose policy permits navigation to GitHub Pages and api.github.com. Require the immutable-source byte-count/SHA-256 gate to reach VERIFICADO before interaction, then smoke-test the four topic-local study surfaces plus applicable wheel/trackpad, grab-drag, and R07 eraser/undo invariants without modifying V11 or any authority pointer.
definition_of_done: https://juanmanuelpm.github.io/prometeo/candidates/jose-v11-reviewable-preview/ loads as the candidate wrapper rather than a browser-policy block page.
The wrapper reaches VERIFICADO only after decoded bytes equal 69235 and SHA-256 equals 0cf9a40fb53e977dccb40c9755d668a3ee922ccd61883f19229bb4a113139a05.
The four topic-local map/practice surfaces are smoke-tested after the verification gate passes.
Wheel/trackpad and grab-drag behavior are checked where V11 exposes them.
Where eraser/undo behavior is present, pressed-only eraser and reversibility constraints from R07 are regression-checked.
No Current, Catalog, Lineage, Human Accepted or Served pointer is changed.
